HCL Infosystems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Committee Meeting held on October 20, 2017.Dear Sirs,We hereby wish to inform you that the meeting of the Rights Issue Committee of the Board of HCL Infosystems Limited held on 20th October, 2017 has decided the following:a) Issue of Equity Shares by way of Rights Issue to the eligible shareholders of the Company, for an amount aggregating to Rs. 499.09 crores;  b) The Rights Issue to be offered at a price of Rs. 47 (Rs. Forty Seven only) including a premium of Rs. 45 (Rs. Forty Five only);c) The total number of rights equity shares to be issued: 106,190,299;d) Rights entitlement ratio is fixed at a ratio of 10 (Ten) rights equity share for every 21 (Twenty One) equity share held by the eligible shareholders of the Company whose names appear on the Register of Members or list of depositories as members or beneficial owners, as at the end of business hours on the Record date;e) Record Date for the purpose of determining the shareholders eligible to apply for the Equity shares in the Rights Issue is Wednesday, 1st November, 2017.Kindly take the above subject matter into your records and also request you to disseminate the said information on your website.Yours Faithfully,For HCL Infosystems LimitedSushil Kumar JainCompany Secretary

HCL Infosystems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Committee Meeting to be held on October 20, 2017.Dear Sirs,In continuation with our letter dated 13th October, 2017, we hereby inform you that a meeting of the Rights Issue Committee of the Board of HCL Infosystems Limited is scheduled to be held on Friday, 20th October, 2017 to consider the following:a) Consider Rights Issue size, fix the Rights Issue price and ratio for rights entitlements; b) Fix the record date for the purpose of Rights Issue.Kindly take the above subject matter into your records and also request you to disseminate the said information on your website.Yours Faithfully,For HCL Infosystems LimitedSushil Kumar JainCompany Secretary

HCL Infosystems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'The Board of Directors in its meeting held on 14th September, 2017 has accepted the resignation of Mr. S G Murali from the position of Group CFO and has appointed Mr. Kapil Kapur as the Deputy CFO of the Company. The Board has also authorized any one of the employees as per the attached letter for determining materiality of an event or information and for the purpose of making disclosure to the stock exchanges. This is for your information and records. Thanking You, Yours sincerely For HCL Infosystems Limited '.

HCL Infosystems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'certain promoters and members of the promoter group of HCL Infosystems Limited (our Company ) had approached us with the request that they be reclassified from the Promoter and Promoter Group category to the Public category. In terms of the Application, we had sought your approval for such reclassification. Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 read with Schedule III to the Listing Regulations, we wish to inform you that the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, vide its letter dated September 13, 2017 (the Letter ), has given its approval for the reclassification of the promoters and members of the promoter group of our Company as public shareholders under Regulation 31A of the Listing Regulations as per the attached file. Request you to take the above information on record. '.

HCL Infosystems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on September 14, 2017.Intimation regarding change in the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company - Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015Pursuant to the provisions of Clause 30 of the Listing Agreement, this is to inform you that Mr. S G Murali, Group Chief Financial Officer has informed the Company about his decision to relinquish the said position with the Company effective September 15, 2017 to pursue new career opportunities. Mr. S G Murali has been associated with the Company since April 1, 2015.The Company has identified Mr. Kapil Kapur, Dy CFO to lead the function and ensure a seamless transition of duties. Mr. Kapil Kapur is a Chartered Accountant with rich experience and has been with the Company since April 1993.Further, the Audit Committee of the Company has accepted Mr. Murali s resignation, which was also endorsed by the Board of Directors. The Board wishes him success in his future endeavor.

HCL Infosystems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 29, 2017.Dear Sir / Madam,Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 read with Schedule III to the Listing Regulations, we wish to inform you that the board of directors (the  Board ) of HCL Infosystems Limited (the  Company ) in its meeting held today i.e., 29th August, 2017 has considered and approved the recommendations of its Capital Raising Committee to go for a rights issue of shares to existing shareholders of the Company as a mode of raising equity capital aggregating up to Rs. 500 crores.The Capital Raising Committee was formed pursuant to resolution dated 3rd July, 2017 passed by the Board, wherein the Board inter alia constituted a Capital Raising Committee to evaluate capital raising alternatives/options and give a final recommendation to the Board for its approval.Please take this on your record.Thanking youVery truly yours,For HCL Infosystems LimitedSushil Kumar JainCompany Secretary & Compliance Officer
